The owner name is the branch suffix (s2/<owner>). A key ending in / owns everything under it; the longest matching key wins. A path no key matches is owned by nobody and fails for everyone.
Ownership changes are sequential and dated: the main session APPENDS {owner, since, why} to a path's list (never edits or deletes an entry). The LAST entry is the current owner.
db/* branches (sql/ records, database objects) ship to main through ship-version and are not checked here.
